bio.text: Gregory W. Meeks represents New York's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; his official biography describes him as being in his thirteenth term.
According to his official biography, he grew up in East Harlem, earned a bachelor's degree in history from Adelphi University and attended Howard University Law School.

He worked as a Queens County Assistant District Attorney and as chief administrative judge of New York State's workers' compensation system, was elected to the New York State Assembly in 1992, and won a 1998 special election to Congress.
